subject: POC Observability & Success Criteria - FintechX
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fintechx.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechx.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodai.com, dev.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability & Success Criteria - FintechX

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:

Recap from today's call:
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate Redwood inference for FintechX core transaction classification and embeddings for search.
- Primary success criteria (from the call): latency stability, cost per 1M tokens, and traceable quality regressions on a defined eval set.
- Main constraints: per-tenant telemetry, data retention policies (security), and observability integration with your Datadog instance.

Proposed POC evaluation plan (high level):
1) Success criteria (finalize with you):
   - Latency: p95 generation latency <= 150ms for 512-token context under sample load profile.
   - Reliability: error rate (5xx + malformed responses) < 0.5% over 24h windows.
   - Cost: token unit cost target <= $X/1k tokens (we'll provide estimates based on observed throughput).
   - Quality: no regression on the 200-example prompt set (we'll run automated evals nightly).
2) Observability & metrics to collect during POC (we'll stand these up in dashboards):
   - Request/response metrics: requests/sec, tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, request queue length.
   - Model runtime metrics: GPU utilization, memory usage, batching rate, KV cache hit/miss rate, cache eviction counts.
   - Errors: per-route error counts, decoding failures, timeouts, model fallback events.
   - Quality signals: eval pass rate on the fixed prompt set, similarity scores for embeddings, top-k rerank stability.
   - Tracing: end-to-end traces with request_id, span for routing, model execution, and response post-processing.
   - Logs: structured request/response metadata (no raw PII), audit logs for data access.
3) Telemetry integrations:
   - Primary: Datadog dashboards + traces (preferred by FintechX).
   - Backup: S3 export of structured logs and BigQuery export for batch analysis.
4) Ownership / roles:
   - Redwood: Marissa will own test harness integration + dashboard build; Jordan (me) owning timeline and escalation; Dev will review security/data retention.
   - FintechX: Elena to own product acceptance and dataset for evals; Tom to support infra/tracing access.
5) Timeline (target):
   - Aug 14: Technical deep-dive + observability kickoff (30-60m).
   - Aug 15-17: Redwood ships baseline dashboards + tracing spans.
   - Aug 18-31: Active POC run and nightly evals.
   - Sep 1: POC review and go/no-go decision.

Attachments: I've attached a short "POC_Observability_Checklist.xlsx" and a draft Mutual Action Plan PDF.

Please confirm the success criteria (especially the latency p95 target) and that Aug 14 works for your team for the tech deep-dive. If you want, we can split the deep-dive into two sessions (infra + SRE with Tom, and product + evals with Elena).

Next steps (if we get a thumbs up):
- Marissa will send calendar invites for Aug 14 and share the dashboard links once provisioned.
- Dev will send a short note with required IAM/Datadog keys/access patterns.
- Jordan will update the HubSpot deal with the finalized MAP and timeline.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@fintechx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechx.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability & Success Criteria - FintechX

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. High level agreement on the plan and timeline. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: p95 <= 150ms looks reasonable as a target for the POC; our internal goal is to be under 120ms for critical inference paths. We can treat 150ms as acceptable for the POC baseline.
- Quality: we'll provide the 200-example evaluation set by EOD Wed (Aug 12). We also want nightly diffs on top-3 rerank stability for our search path.
- Telemetry: Datadog is preferred. We'll provide a read-only API key and a tracing ingest endpoint; Tom will follow up with specifics.
- Security: we need a short writeup on what request/response fields are logged and retention windows. Dev's review will be important here.

We can do Aug 14 at 10:00am PT for the technical deep-dive (Tom will join). Can you send invites?

I'll loop in our procurement contact separately for the PO / MSA; for the POC we can proceed on an evaluation agreement.

Elena
Product Manager, FintechX

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fintechx.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechx.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodai.com, dev.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability & Success Criteria - FintechX

Perfect — thanks Elena. Confirming next actions and owners (this message will serve as the POC observability plan to reference):

1) Technical deep-dive
   - When: Aug 14, 10:00am PT (invite sent). Owner: Marissa (will host + share screens).

2) Dashboard & tracing plan (deliverables) — Owner: Marissa
   - Per-route latency dashboard: p50/p95/p99, requests/sec, tokens/sec.
   - Error dashboard: 5xx, decoding failures, timeouts, fallback rate.
   - Model runtime dashboard: GPU util, memory pressure, batch size distribution, KV cache hit/miss rate.
   - Quality dashboard: nightly eval pass rate on the 200-example set; top-3 rerank delta heatmap.
   - Traces: sample end-to-end trace collection with span attributes: request_id, route, model_variant, tokens_in/tokens_out, batch_id.

3) Log export & storage — Owner: Dev Patel
   - Export structured logs (JSON lines) to your S3 bucket every 24h (or streaming if preferred).
   - Retention: default 30 days for POC, can extend to 90 days on request. We'll provide the exact schema of the exported fields for your security review (no raw user PII included by default).

4) Alerts & thresholds — Owners: Marissa + FintechX SRE
   - Latency p95 alert: threshold 200ms (warn at 150ms) during POC.
   - Error rate alert: warn at 0.3%, page at 1%.
   - GPU util alerts: page if GPU util < 30% with high queue length or > 95% sustained for 5m.

5) CI / Eval cadence
   - Nightly automated evals against the 200-example set; Slack alert to FintechX product channel if pass rate drops > 3% from baseline.

6) Security review
   - Dev will send the logging schema and retention details by EOD Aug 12 for your security team review.

Attachments: attaching the POC checklist and a draft MAP.

Next steps for us (short):
- Marissa: build and share Datadog dashboard links 24-48h after deep-dive.
- Dev: send log schema + Datadog integration steps by EOD Aug 12.
- Jordan: update HubSpot and confirm resource availability.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Jordan
